tips.text: Don't sell or delete Odonata before rank 30; replacing it costs 250,000 Simaris standing.
Level it on Salacia, Neptune Archwing Mobile Defense; two runs with an affinity booster max arch weapons too.
Level the Imperator and Veritux in the same Salacia runs; they are separate Mastery items.
Save the levelling for an affinity booster weekend or a daily booster.
Wait five to ten seconds after a Plains camp spawns before shooting, or you lose the stealth bonus.
If the quest stays on build the Odonata after you claim it, open the Codex quest menu, select The Archwing and press Begin.
Contact support if built parts vanish from inventory before the main craft.
File a support ticket if an unranked sale blocked your Mastery; players report it being honoured.
Nobody treats Odonata as a farm; it is a 30-minute quest, and players swap to Itzal or Amesha but keep it until rank 30.
